problem_and_repair.contract: Mapping reads remain ordinary JSON dict/list/scalar values; payload and __getitem__ return detached deep copies. dict(projection) and dict(projection.items()) remain recursively mutable caller copies. Input payload mutations after construction do not alter the projection. Evidence stays attached and unchanged.
problem_and_repair.mechanism: DemographyRoleProjection captures a private recursive JSON snapshot on construction. Public payload access and __getitem__ return detached copies; iteration exposes only validated string keys; equality compares the private snapshot. Dataclass field names, constructor argument order, repr/asdict/replace behavior, mapping equality, and unhashability were checked.
alternatives: Chosen: owner-local recursive defensive snapshot and detached reads. This preserves ordinary dict/list caller semantics and avoids cross-domain coupling.
Rejected: MappingProxyType or frozen dataclass alone, which leaves nested mutable aliases.
Rejected: private IR frozen-container helpers, because this public API promises dict(projection) as a mutable copy and should not depend on another domain's private implementation.
problem_and_repair.authority_boundary: No authority, currentness, semantic-completeness, or admissibility is inferred. Candidate evidence remains candidate_only; authority/currentness/semantic-completeness remain not_established.
